Phase-5.NAME: SnarcMemoryIntegration
Phase-5.purpose: Integrate SNARC salience-gated memory into Reasonix prompt, tool, compaction, stop, MCP, and dashboard flows.

steps.step-1: Port SQLite memory schema, SNARC scorer, search, stats, briefing, and consolidation.
steps.step-2: Wire Reasonix PostToolUse and UserPromptSubmit equivalents to SNARC capture and related-memory injection.
steps.step-3: Add compaction capture before context folding loses high-value conversation turns.
steps.step-4: Route deep dream through Reasonix model client or keep it explicitly optional.
steps.step-5: Expose SNARC MCP/native tools through Reasonix.
steps.step-6: Add dashboard visibility for memory health, search, patterns, and identity review.
